The issuer demonstrates solid profitability with an operating margin of approximately 21.8% and a healthy equity cushion of $2.35B, but exhibits notable liquidity pressure with a current ratio of 0.72x (current liabilities exceed current assets by $372M) and a relatively high total liabilities-to-assets ratio of ~76.1%. While generating stable earnings to support its balance sheet, the near-term refinancing and working capital deficit balance its overall profile into the upper-medium speculative tier.

DECISION: BB+
